newsitem.title: KUWAIT: KNPC refining capacity up 30,000 bpd to 850,000.
newsitem.headline: KNPC refining capacity up 30,000 bpd to 850,000.

text.p: State-owned oil refiner Kuwait National Petroleum Co (KNPC) said its refining capacity rose to 850,000 barrels per day (bpd) from 820,000 bpd.
"KNPC said its refining capacity from the refineries of Mina al-Ahmadi, Mina Abdulla and Mina al-Shuaiba reached...850,000 bpd," the official Kuwait News Agency said late on Wednesday.
Mina al-Shuaiba will restore its pre-Gulf War capacity of 195,000 bpd in January from a current capacity of 160,000 bpd, the agency said.
Most of the Gulf state's oil production and refining facilities were damaged during the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation of Kuwait.
Mina al-Ahmadi refinery processes 440,000 bpd and Mina Abdulla refinery processes some 250,000 bpd, said the agency.
KNPC, which runs Kuwait three local refineries, is the refining arm of the Kuwait Petoleum Corp KPC which oversees the oil sector. OPEC member Kuwait has a crude production quota of 2.0 million bpd.
